name: Kingdom of Eldora - Way of the Prince
source:
In the Kingdom of Eldora, an ancient tradition decides the fate of the throne. The wise king gives his sons a chance to prove their right to rule not by blood, but by deeds. The three princes enter the fray, unaware that their choices will unleash forces that have slumbered for centuries.

The eldest, Kaellan, leads his knights north to crush bands of vicious marauders. But beneath the masks of these bandits lurk demons, seeking to open a portal to this world.

The youngest, Lir, brings mercy to the forgotten lands, where the kingdom's foot has not trod for decades. His kindness may become the last shield—or the most vulnerable target.

And the middle son, Elian, walks the darkest path. He seeks a legendary artifact capable of granting boundless power. But the ancient scrolls hide the truth: this artifact is the only thing that can destroy the demons... or summon their master for good.

Their personal rivalry awakens an ancient evil. Now, the battle for the throne will become a battle for the survival of the entire continent. Immerse yourself in a world where every decision leads to glory or ruin. Where lust and betrayal are weapons as potent as sword and magic. And where the price of the crown is the soul of the one who seizes it.

[From [url=https://mens-house.itch.io/the-kingdom-of-eldora-the-way-of-the-prince]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在埃尔多拉王国，一个古老的传统决定了王位的命运。明智的国王给他的儿子们一个机会来证明他们的统治权，不是通过血缘，而是通过行动。三位王子加入了战斗，却没有意识到他们的选择将释放沉睡了几个世纪的力量。

最年长的凯兰带领他的骑士向北粉碎邪恶的掠夺者队伍。但在这些强盗的面具下潜伏着恶魔，试图打开通往这个世界的大门。

最年轻的李尔为这片被遗忘的土地带来了仁慈，那里的王国已经数十年没有踏足过。他的善良可能会成为最后的盾牌——或者说是最脆弱的目标。

而二儿子埃连则走上了最黑暗的道路。他寻找一件能够赋予无限力量的传奇神器。但远古卷轴隐藏了真相：这件神器是唯一能够消灭恶魔的东西……或者永远召唤他们的主人。

他们的个人竞争唤醒了古老的邪恶。现在，王位争夺战将变成整个大陆的生死存亡之战。让自己沉浸在一个每一个决定都会导致荣耀或毁灭的世界中。欲望和背叛是与剑和魔法一样强大的武器。而王冠的代价就是夺取它的人的灵魂。

[来自[url=https://mens-house.itch.io/the-kingdom-of-eldora-the-way-of-the-prince]Itch.io[/url]]
